description: A review of the mechanisms behind the mismatch negativity, an automatic brain response to a broken sensory rule, weighed the adaptation and model adjustment hypotheses and proposed predictive coding as a framework that unifies both.
limitations: A review that proposes a unifying account. It is not a decisive test between the hypotheses.

sources.quote: This paper presents a review of studies that focus on neuronal mechanisms underlying the MMN generation, discusses the two major explanatory hypotheses, and proposes predictive coding as a general framework that attempts to unify both.
